subject.name: NASA Perseverance rover
identity_constraints: The subject must be NASA's Perseverance Mars rover.
The subject must not become Curiosity, Opportunity, Spirit, a generic rover, a lunar rover, or a fictional rover.
The rover must remain an unmanned robotic vehicle.
The rover must retain six wheels, a central chassis, a mast/camera head, and a front robotic arm with an instrument turret.

rendering_requirements.target_graphic: annotated technical infographic / engineering atlas plate
rendering_requirements.label_density: full instrument labels plus major subsystem labels
rendering_requirements.background_policy: decorative Mars background allowed only if it does not obscure rover geometry or labels
rendering_requirements.logo_policy: avoid NASA logo use unless explicitly allowed by later policy

geometry: Six wheels must remain visible or logically present.
Wheel arrangement must follow rocker-bogie rover layout.
Mast must rise from the rover body, not from the arm.
Robotic arm must attach to the front/body area.
Instrument turret must be at the end of the robotic arm.
The rover must not gain tank tracks, solar panels, cockpit glass, human seats, or animal-like legs.

component_location.MOXIE: represented as an internal/body-mounted technology payload, not an external antenna
component_location.RIMFAX: associated with the lower/rear underside antenna region
component_location.MEDA: represented as environmental sensors, not a camera cluster

style: decorative Mars background allowed only if it does not obscure rover geometry or labels
avoid NASA logo use unless explicitly allowed by later policy

approval_contract.guardrail: Uncertainty must produce needs_review, not approval.
